proposal: Fix the recurring 'venue-blind vinter→NRK-klobb' in scripts/lib/norwegian-rights.js (the old single line 242: all winter sports → [CH.nrk]). Norwegian winter rights splintered for 2026/27 and are no longer resolvable by sport alone: biathlon (IBU World Cup) is NRK + TV 2 shared, split WEEKEND-BY-WEEKEND (Kontiolahti → TV 2 Play; Hochfilzen/Antholz → NRK), and alpine (FIS World Cup) is split PER RACE across TV 2 Play / Viaplay / NRK (Levi → TV 2 Play, Gurgl → Viaplay, Norwegian venues → NRK). The flat NRK default silently clobbered the researched channel on every static rebuild. The fix makes biathlon + alpine DECLINE to guess (return []) so the research/verify-supplied Norwegian channel survives — the exact guess-no-more pattern already used for the UEFA-qualifier and tiered-golf carve-outs in the same file. Cross-country, ski jumping and nordic combined keep the confident NRK default: the Norwegian-venue season openers (Beitostølen, Lillehammer hopp, Ruka langrenn) were all web-verified NRK this cycle.
evidence: research-log.json 2026-11-15 WARNING-OBSERVASJON: 'validate-events melder 6 summary↔streaming-mismatch på Kontiolahti-skiskyting (summary navner TV 2, streaming[]=[NRK]) — den dokumenterte norwegian-rights.js L242 venue-blinde vinter→NRK-klobben; en bar research-streaming[]-redigering klobbes tilbake av pipelinen ... Korrekt kanal = TV 2 Play. STRUKTURELT self-repair/improve-flagg står.' Repeated as a carry-forward STRUKTURELT flag at the end of the same log.

Live docs/data/events.json confirms the firing bug exactly: all 6 Kontiolahti biathlon events (26.–29. nov) carry streaming[]=[NRK] while their summary names 'TV 2 Play' — a 6-way summary↔streaming mismatch still reported by `node scripts/validate-events.js` this run ('Summary↔streaming mismatch on 6 event(s)'). The verify-amended alpine events (Levi → TV 2 Play, Gurgl → Viaplay) already agree, proving the per-weekend/per-race reality and that only unverified winter events get clobbered.

.claude/skills/norwegian-rights/SKILL.md § Winter sports (updated 2026-11-14, multi-source: NRK's own 2026/27 winter program + langrenn.com + sportsidioten.no + NTB press release 17879914 for biathlon; TV 2 season press release 19113452 + telenor/streamix per-race table for alpine) documents biathlon as 'NRK + TV 2 share, split per weekend [verify per weekend]' with Kontiolahti explicitly → TV 2 / TV 2 Play, and alpine as 'split per race from 2026/27' across TV 2 Play / Viaplay / NRK. The code's flat winter→NRK contradicted the skill it claims to mirror.

The fix mirrors the file's own established pattern. The same 'decline to guess so the researched channel survives' carve-out already exists for Norwegian-club UEFA qualifiers (the Glimt/Brann/Tromsø revert-war) and for tiered golf (the Corales/DP-World revert-wars) — both documented in-file as cases where a confident-but-wrong map default clobbered a correct researched value on every hourly rebuild. Winter is the same failure mode; this extends the existing remedy rather than adding machinery (the improve bias).

Simulation through the fixed map: a fresh research/verify biathlon event with [TV 2 Play] survives as [TV 2 Play]; alpine with [Viaplay] survives as [Viaplay]; a Norwegian-venue cross-country event with no channel still defaults to [NRK]; genuinely foreign nets (ARD/FOX) are still dropped to []. So recall and the foreign-net guard are unchanged; only the winter over-guess is removed.

npm test: 88 files / 1554 tests pass (1550 → +4 new norwegian-rights cases: biathlon declines, alpine declines, the three Nordic disciplines stay NRK, and an end-to-end normalizeStreaming case proving a researched TV 2 Play survives). Paths touched: scripts/lib/norwegian-rights.js + tests/ — both non-protected → auto-merge-eligible.

Deliberately NOT chosen: (a) extending the winter authority.json contract-blocks to cover November (coverage-audit's suggested fix for the Beitostølen miss) — the contracts' own note documents November as a BEVISST exclusion to avoid ragged-edge false HIGH breaches (exactly the G2 noise last week's FIFA-break improve run warned against), and this run the research/coverage-critic ragged-edge loop WORKED (Beitostølen caught + escalated); reversing a deliberate, documented design choice on one escalation is not a clear win. (b) The research-escalation allowed_bots breakage (self-repair-log, open issue #430) — a protected .github/workflows path a CI agent may not author. (c) Visual-QA --max-turns tuning — also a protected .github/workflows change.
expectedEffect: From the next build on, a freshly researched or verify-amended biathlon/alpine event keeps its correct Norwegian channel (TV 2 Play / Viaplay / NRK as researched) instead of being force-clobbered to NRK by the rights map. The 6 currently-stored Kontiolahti events are already damaged (research's [TV 2 Play] was overwritten to [NRK] on the first build and persisted); they self-heal when verify's daily 7-day pass reaches them (~19–22 Nov, Kontiolahti being 26–29 Nov) and amends the channel — which this fix then preserves instead of re-clobbering. No new NRK-default events are created wrongly; Nordic-discipline openers at Norwegian venues still default NRK.
howWeKnow: After the fix ships: (1) validate-events' 'Summary↔streaming mismatch' count drops to 0 for the Kontiolahti biathlon events once verify amends them within its 7-day window (and stays 0 — the map no longer fights the amendment). (2) A future biathlon weekend on TV 2 or alpine race on Viaplay boards with its correct channel on the FIRST build, no verify round-trip needed. (3) Regression guard: if a biathlon/alpine event ever shows a foreign net, the NORWEGIAN_RE filter still dropped it (tested). If a Nordic-discipline opener at a Norwegian venue loses its NRK channel, the second winter branch needs widening.
notes: Scope held to the two disciplines with CLEAR documented evidence that a flat NRK default is wrong (biathlon + alpine, each with named per-weekend/per-race venue examples in the skill and firing/verified evidence on the live board). Cross-country/ski-jumping/nordic-combined kept on NRK because this cycle's web-verify put the Norwegian-venue openers (Beitostølen, Lillehammer, Ruka) on NRK — changing those would introduce a NEW unverified default, the opposite of the fix's intent.

The regression surface is narrow and acceptable: a biathlon/alpine event with NO researched channel now shows an honest '–' instead of a confident NRK guess that is wrong roughly half the weekends. That is the file's stated philosophy ('ALWAYS show a Norwegian channel (or honestly nothing), never a foreign broadcaster') — honest-empty over confident-wrong — and in practice research/verify always supply the channel (every live winter event's summary already names it).

Did not touch the skill: .claude/skills/norwegian-rights/SKILL.md already documents the correct split in more detail than the code; the code now references that section by name so the two stay aligned.
